# Axiom

> Axiom is a background reference on AI model architectures — deep learning foundations, attention and transformers, mixture-of-experts, state-space models, and more. It is not a chapter companion in its own right; it underpins the model-selection guidance in the OASIS methodology's Chapter 14 and is cross-linked from Forge and Ageis wherever they use model-architecture terminology.

See [Knowledge Map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/AXIOM/master/00-navigation-and-methodology/knowledge-map.md), [Architecture Taxonomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/AXIOM/master/00-navigation-and-methodology/architecture-taxonomy.md), and [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/AXIOM/master/INDEX.md) for full navigation.

## Foundations and classical architectures

- [Convolutional Neural Networks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/AXIOM/master/02-classical-neural-architectures/convolutional-neural-networks.md)
